apps.name: Until
apps.tagline: Count down to anything, and count up from the days that matter: events, birthdays, subscriptions and deadlines, with reminders, widgets and Google Drive backup.

notes: New moments start on today's date, so the date picker opens on today.
Choose when all-day reminders arrive right on the edit screen: when the day starts (00:00), in the morning (09:00), or any other time.
Shareable countdowns: send a link to a live countdown page anyone can open; Add to Until opens it in the app
App lock: passcode with fingerprint or face, screenshots blocked and widget titles hidden while on
Category tiles on Home and album covers: each category gets its own icon, colour and cover photo
Until tells you when a new version is out (on Home, by notification, and in Settings > Check for updates).
Permanent signing key, so future updates install over this version.
Privacy policy, linked from Settings.
releases.important: Until now has its permanent signing key, so this one update can't install over an older version. Once only: in Until go to Settings > Google Drive backup and back up (or Save a backup file), uninstall the old Until, install 1.4.0, then restore. Future updates install normally.

notes: Home-screen widgets follow each moment's screen style: Classic, Dots, Clock, Ring, Photo or Minimal.
Categories screen: open a category to see only its moments, and add straight into it.
All cards are the same size, and every card shows its date or price.
All cards on Home and in categories are the same size, so they line up in neat rows.
Every card shows its date, or its price for subscriptions.
Categories screen: see how many moments each category has and what comes next, and open one to see only its moments.
"Add to Family" starts a new moment already in that category.
Screen styles for each countdown: Classic, Dots, Clock, Ring, Photo and Minimal.
Search on Home, and a cards or list view.
Fixed choosing a photo for a card.
First version: events, count-ups, birthdays, subscriptions and deadlines, repeating countdowns, your own categories, reminders and milestones, widgets, sharing as a picture, and backups.

apps.name: Ultimate HD WA Status
apps.tagline: Sharper WhatsApp Status videos: splits long videos into Status-length parts at the best quality, adds music and a watermark, and saves statuses you've seen.

notes: No ads: tapping Process starts right away.
Fully offline: the app no longer needs internet access.
Quality-first engine: presets are now quality levels (Max 1080p, Balanced 720p, Safe 720p) instead of file-size targets.
Never enlarges small videos, and keeps the original file untouched when it's already WhatsApp-ready.
Checks free space before starting.
New name, Ultimate HD WA Status, and a new icon.
Watermark: put your name or brand on the video, in any corner, in three sizes.
Preview and trim background music; higher music quality (192 kbps).
Background music for every part, with smooth fades. Works with photos too.

apps.name: Future Me
apps.tagline: A private time-capsule diary: letters to your future self (or to someone else), snapshots, predictions and milestones, encrypted on your phone and backed up to your Google Drive.

notes: Home-screen widgets: a countdown to your next sealed letter, and quick add for letters, snapshots, predictions and milestones.
With the app lock on, the widget hides titles and names.
Back from a widget or notification now goes to Home.
Search everything you wrote (sealed letters only by name, so nothing is spoiled).
Backup status on Home, and a gentle weekly reminder when new entries aren't backed up.
Letters to other people are delivered into their Google Drive on the chosen date.
Live countdown on sealed letters; safer backups and restores.
Everything is encrypted on the phone; backups always use a password.
New design, and app lock with PIN, fingerprint or face.
First version.

apps.name: Folio
apps.tagline: Your passports, IDs, cards and insurance in one encrypted wallet: scan or import documents, get reminded before they expire, fill and sign PDFs, and back up to your own Google Drive.

notes: Fill & sign: add text, today's date, ticks, crosses, highlights and your saved signature to PDFs, photos and scans. Saves a new copy; the original is untouched.
Expiring next widget for the home screen (shows document types, not names, unless you turn names on).
Automatic Google Drive backup a minute after you add or change something (Wi-Fi only by default).
Encrypted wallet for passports, IDs, licences, insurance and cards, with expiry reminders, scanner, document reader and convert to PDF.
